Game Overview

In Bear Jump, the core idea is straightforward: leap into excitement with Bear Jump, where you guide an adventurous bear through infinite skies. Time your jumps perfectly as you dodge wild boars and spikes, collecting power-ups for an extra boost. Master the art of vertical ascent and beat your high score in this thrilling, addictive skyward journey!
